question: Can I get a refund on my annual plan?

retrieved.text: Annual plans can be refunded within 30 days of purchase. Monthly plans are not refundable, but you can cancel at any time and keep access until the end of the billing period.
The Enterprise plan includes a 99.95% monthly uptime SLA. Service credits are issued when uptime falls below the SLA.

answer: Yes. Annual plans can be refunded within 30 days of purchase [kb-refund]. Monthly plans are not refundable, but you keep access until the end of the billing period [kb-refund].

question: Which plans include SSO?

question: What happens if I exceed the API rate limit, and what should my client do?

retrieved.text: The public API allows 600 requests per minute per workspace. Requests over the limit receive HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.
Clients should retry 429 and 503 responses with exponential backoff and jitter, starting at 1 second and capping at 30 seconds.

answer: The API allows 600 requests per minute per workspace, and requests over the limit get HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header [kb-ratelimit]. Your client should retry with exponential backoff and jitter, starting at 1 second and capping at 30 seconds [kb-retry].
